status_codes.OK: Clean run. Both tone and motor onsets caught successfully.
status_codes.REC_ERROR: Sounddevice choked or returned a messed-up buffer.
status_codes.CLIPPED: Mic input maxed out (>= 0.99); timing data is trash.
status_codes.NO_TONE: Tone never crossed the threshold inside the search window.
status_codes.LOW_TONE_SNR: Tone was buried in room noise (< 10 dB SNR).
status_codes.TONE_OUT_OF_WINDOW: Tone popped up outside the expected 0.6–1.2s window.
status_codes.ALREADY_BUZZING: Motor was already vibrating before the jump happened.
status_codes.NO_MOTOR: Couldn't find a valid motor activation signature within 500ms post-jump.
status_codes.ANALYSIS_ERROR: Something unexpected broke during DSP analysis (check log).
